title: Isolated Python workspace and code editor
summary: First incremental Python upgrade: browser execution, CodeMirror editor, local drafts and saved script copies, bounded console history and offline error guidance.

changes.detail: Browser Python runs in an opaque-origin sandbox iframe and disposable worker with startup and execution deadlines. CodeMirror provides Python highlighting, brackets, indentation, completion, search/replace, undo, shortcuts and error markers.

Web Python tab uses the learning workspace. Existing PC terminal runtimes, Android CPython, authentication and lesson progress remain in place. Drafts and named script copies reuse the existing progress store.
Separate stdout/stderr, duration, stop/restart/clear/copy, last 20 runs, general error explanations and optional existing AI teacher handoff.

validation.name: Initial type check
validation.detail: npm.cmd run typecheck passed after CodeMirror installation and JSX correction.

validation.name: Behavior and runtime verification
validation.detail: Pending tests. Pre-entered input only; live input prompts, cloud script sync, full course expansion and new native editor are not included. Native and iOS device behavior untested. No deployment.
